title: FAST_TDA molecular two-photon corpus
summary: Generate closed-shell orbital references with resident GFN2 and qualify pure-TDA two-photon tensors against std2 state-to-state moments before comparing with RPA response.
gates: every wfn.xtb is generated once and then held immutable for resident and external calculations
pure-TDA tensor parity uses identically truncated intermediate-state sums
the omitted high-state tail is reported separately from implementation parity
RPA results are labelled as a model comparison and tracked by electronic character
external calculations are frozen to one OpenMP thread
coordinate_policy: Each atom order, geometry and Cartesian frame is immutable after corpus construction.
backend_policy: Resident GFN2 generates the orbital reference; FAST_TDA is the production response and std2 is an external qualification oracle only.
